_comment: ABLATION SCREEN (2026-06-17). Single phase, full cartesian over every filter/exit TOGGLE while the entry oscillator core (RSIPeriod/RSIOversold/Stoch*) stays pinned at NVTK's calibrated DefaultParams. Goal: see which filters actually earn their keep before spending grids tuning them. Each toggle's companion params are pinned to a WORKING value (not the default) so an enabled filter is never silently inert — e.g. UseRegime needs ADXPeriod>0, UseTrail needs TrailATRMult>0. Read the result by scanning the top-ranked rows: a toggle that is consistently ON in the winners helps; one that is ON/OFF at random (or consistently OFF) is dead weight to drop. 2^10 = 1024 combos. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker NVTK -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/nvtk/reversion_screen.json -out ./reports/NVTK_screen -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20 -risk-pct 1
